# proposal-store-v1 provenance

- The two files are byte copies of the batch goldens of `demo/stand-in-ai/golden/artifacts/proposal-store/batches/` as committed before task 10.14 (git commit `1b0e5f9`, format `"version":1`). `sha256sum` of each file equals its pre-change golden.
- They are kept unchanged as evidence that a version 1 batch is still read and printed byte for byte after Proposal_Store format version 2 (UD-37, Req 35.17). They are not regenerated.
- The demonstration goldens themselves were changed to version 2 by the same task, which is recorded in that commit message.
